1251-5078-6650-8171.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
1251-5078-6650-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

101-5531-5694-6664-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
101-5531-5694-6664-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Vampire Charmseeker and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Vampire Charmseeker and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.
101-5531-5694-6664-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Vampire Charmseeker and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

requires.n: One-drop creature with a second body

1957-4050-4063--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Fleshtaker trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Fleshtaker ability, gaining at least one life and causing at least one opponent to lose at least one life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

4247-6103-6105.description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, causing you to choose how players vote this turn and drawing a card.
Cast Magister of Worth by paying {4}{W}{B}.
When Magister of Worth enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Magister of Worth and any number of other creatures.
Resolve the Magister of Worth trigger, having each player vote for grace, returning all creatures from graveyards to the battlefield.
Resolve all abilities from step 4.
Repeat from 3.

1981-2324-2415-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding one mana of any color
When the creature dies, Proper Burial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

997-1981-2415-2999.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
997-1981-2415-2999.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

277-851-1308-4772-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

643-3413-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Maskwood Nexus, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2685-3263-4186-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-3263-4186-6824.description:
Gain life in any way.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

900-5928-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Incredible Hulk.
900-5928-7124.description:
Deal combat damage using The Incredible Hulk. 
Sword of Feast and Famine triggers. Holding priorty, activate a land other than Balduvian Trading Post by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Balduvian Trading Post's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and then untapping it and causing you to gain an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Sword of Feast and Famine trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Repeat each combat phase.

969-6006-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
969-6006-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
969-6006-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-7725.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Selfless Police Captain.
When Selfless Police Captain dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a Forest you control

2092-4954-5227.description:
Activate the land with Utopia Sprawl attached by tapping it, adding {1}.
Utopia Sprawl triggers, adding {1}.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping the land and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.
2092-4954-5227.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

3698-6871-6879-7298.description:
Cast Firdoch Core by paying {3}.
When Firdoch Core enters, Grinding Station and Haru trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Haru trigger, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.

849-2921-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
849-2921-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Anax and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1692-6753-7150.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping two creatures you control, copying the Helm of the Host trigger.
Resolve the copy of the Helm of the Host trigger, creating two token copies of Kirol that aren't legendary.
Holding priority, activate the Kirol token by tapping two creatures you control, copying the Helm of the Host trigger.
Repeat from step 3.

1061-4603-5223.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 4 or greater.
You have the city's blessing or control at least nine permanents.
1061-4603-5223.notablePrerequisites: You are able to gain at least 3 life per turn.
1061-4603-5223.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Maralen triggers, causing you to lose 3 life and search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Gain at least 3 life.
Repeat each turn.

1395-3713-5078-6006.description:
Activate Steelfin Whale by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

1336-3750.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

2511-5205-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Glint-Sleeve Artisan.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

654-3470-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
654-3470-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer token enters, it triggers, creating a Mutavault land token that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault token enters, Springheart Nantuko, Amulet of Vigor and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the Mutavault token.
Holding priority, activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

3259-5484-6968.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander is on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature that isn't your commander.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control
3259-5484-6968.description:
Declare your commander and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
We Ride at Dawn's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Mercenary creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Mercenary token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

681-5411-6621-6664.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-5411-6621-6664.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat from step 2.

4030-5078-6918.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

3197-6798-6872.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
3197-6798-6872.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1315-2173-4423-4935-6491.manaNeeded: {G} if Enter the Unknown is in your hand
1315-2173-4423-4935-6491.easyPrerequisites: If Enter the Unknown is on top of your library, your life total must be at least 2.
1315-2173-4423-4935-6491.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more Islands.
1315-2173-4423-4935-6491.description:
Cast Enter the Unknown either from your hand by paying {G} or from the top of your library by paying 1 life, causing a creature you control to explore and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play Mystic Sanctuary either from your hand or graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Enter the Unknown from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2091-2511-4558-4863.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least eleven tapped lands.
2091-2511-4558-4863.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Revolutionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Revolutionist by paying its mana cost.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Revolutionist.
Repeat.

586-3771-5147-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
586-3771-5147-5258-5618.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

645-914-3750-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
645-914-3750-5231.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {R}.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 3.

204-969-1858-2056-2633.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-969-1858-2056-2633.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Urabrask and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

618-1558-3263-3667.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Evangel of Heliod with haste.
When the Evangel of Heliod token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Evangel of Heliod token and the Soldier tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

280-1636-4913-5310.notablePrerequisites: Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
280-1636-4913-5310.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, causing you to draw a card and put Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
 When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Bloodghast trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

152-2034-2648.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Phyrexian Triniform with haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Phyrexian Triniform, adding {C}{C}.
When Phyrexian Triniform dies, it triggers, creating three 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing the Golems, adding six {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Cogwork Assembler to make infinite copies of any artifacts you control.

uses.n: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

314-3222-4961.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is greater than an opponent's.
314-3222-4961.description:
Cast Minion of the Wastes by paying {3}{B}{B}{B}, choosing to pay an amount of life equal to an opponent's life total as it enters the battlefield.
Cast Inscription of Abundance by paying {1}{G}, causing you to gain life equal to Minion of the Wastes' power.
Vito triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained this way.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

779-2546-4467.description:
Activate Dakmor Salvage's cycling ability by paying {R} and discarding it.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Dakmor Salvage ability, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

508-1424.notablePrerequisites: Presence of Gond attached to Black Carriage.
508-1424.description:
During your upkeep, activate Black Carriage by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
Activate Black Carriage by sacrificing the Elf Warrior, untapping Black Carriage.
Repeat.

4447-4899.notablePrerequisites: Assault Suit attached to Phyrexian Devourer.
4447-4899.description:
Activate Phyrexian Devourer's second ability by exiling the top card of your library, causing you to put a number of +1/+1 counters on Phyrexian Devourer equal to that card's mana value.
Repeat step 1 until Phyrexian Devourer's power is seven or greater.
Phyrexian Devourer's first ability triggers, causing you to not sacrifice Phyrexian Devourer due to Assault Suit.
Phyrexian Devourer's first ability triggers again, causing a mandatory infinite loop, ending the game in a draw.

603-1424-2034.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond is attached to Galvanic Juggernaut.
Galvanic Juggernaut does not have summoning sickness.
603-1424-2034.description:
Activate Galvanic Juggernaut by tapping it to create 1/1 green Elf Warrior token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the token to add {C}{C}.
Galvanic Juggernaut triggers, untapping.
Repeat.
